name: pm2-wrapper
description: Generate a PM2 command pinned to a resolved Node.js executable.

scripts.test: sh -n scripts/install.sh && sh -n scripts/uninstall.sh && node --check scripts/startup.cjs && node --check scripts/lifecycle.cjs && ./scripts/install.sh --help && ./scripts/uninstall.sh --help && node --test tests/*.test.cjs
